facts.text: I describe a treasury management plan where the treasury and stated wallets engage in calculated sells and buys to maintain steady growth.
I describe selling to re-balance validator investments to generate consistent constant buybacks.
I describe buying back tokens for appreciation or burning to maintain a sustainable growth rate for the long term.
I propose implementing a 7-year referral system.
I state that a person receives rewards for any buys and sells their friend makes for the next 7 years.
I state that the friend receives a discount for those 7 years as well.
I state that if a person opts to not use the referral system they will pay the full price and taxes.
I mention a referral system dapp located at dapp.endgame.black.
I describe offering airdrops from time to time for certain activities in Endgame or Reward tokens.
I state that the sell tax is 20% minus 10% for the use of the referral system.
I state that 3% goes to Reward token reflection.
I state that the Reward token reflection percentage is minus 1% if referred.
I state that 14% goes to Liquidity, RFV, Treasury, #Endgame Champion, Algorithmic Chart Management System, and Burning System.
I state that the 14% allocation is minus 8% if referred.
I state that 2% goes to Battle Royal Champion System.
I state that the Battle Royal Champion System allocation is minus 1% if referred.
I state that 1% goes to a rebaser wallet.
I state that dynamic whale tax is %1 to %10 goes to purchasing reward tokens.
I state that the goal is to reach as close as possible to a zero tax structure.
I state that #Endgame, in the beginning, must have some funds to build the infrastructure towards eventual zero taxes.
I state that decisions about changing taxes will be made over time together with the community.

keyphrases: referral rewards for buys and sells
